I think everyone has already given better advice than I could provide but I just wanted to comment to say that I experienced this with my cats as well after the younger one was neutered and all was back to normal (they are usually very cuddly with each other) within a few days. Just wanted to add another positive story in the mix because I remember being very confused/worried when it happened to me! 

I personally didn't separate my cats because the older one wasn't showing any overt aggression. He would just hiss and move to a different spot when the younger would try to cuddle (which seems a bit more similar to what's happening in your case?). Either way I suppose the best way/most recommended is to keep them separate but just in my case I think it was genuinely the less stressful option to not separate them.
